title: Sweet Potato and Lentil Flour Gnocchi
subtitle: in a sage and yoghurt sauce
description: Gluten-free gnocchi made from mashed sweet potato and lentil flour, pan-fried in butter and sage and finished with a tangy goat's yoghurt sauce.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to its maximum temperature and line a tray with baking paper. Bake the whole unpeeled sweet potatoes for 20 to 30 minutes, until a knife slides easily into the centre. Peel and mash to a smooth puree.
Add the lentil flour and 1/2 tsp salt to the puree and mix to an even, non-sticky mixture.
Roll the mixture into three long ropes about 1.5 cm thick and cut each into ten 1.5 cm pieces. Refrigerate for half an hour.

Bring a large pot of water to the boil with 1 tbsp salt and the olive oil. Cook the gnocchi in batches of five or six, only until they start to float (do not overcook). Lift out with a slotted spoon onto a plate.
Melt the butter in a frying pan and fry the gnocchi for 1 to 2 minutes until golden. Add the sage and fry for 1 more minute.
Add the yoghurt, 1/2 tsp salt and the chilli flakes, stir and bring to the boil. Turn off the heat and serve.
